text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying to them:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel, saying: From among all the land animals, these are the creatures that you may eat.
text_cn: “你们应告诉以色列子民说：地上的一切走兽中，你们可吃的兽类如下：

text_en: Any animal that has divided hoofs and is cleft-footed and chews the cud—such you may eat.
text_cn: 凡走兽中有偶蹄，有趾及反刍的，你们都可以吃。

text_en: But among those that chew the cud or have divided hoofs, you shall not eat the following: the camel, for even though it chews the cud, it does not have divided hoofs; it is unclean for you.
text_cn: 但在反刍或有偶蹄的走兽中，你们不可吃的是骆驼，因为骆驼虽反刍，但偶蹄无趾，对你们仍是不洁的；

text_en: The rock badger, for even though it chews the cud, it does not have divided hoofs; it is unclean for you.
text_cn: 岩貍，它虽反刍，但偶蹄无趾，对你们仍是不洁的；

text_en: The hare, for even though it chews the cud, it does not have divided hoofs; it is unclean for you.
text_cn: 兔子虽反刍，偶蹄无趾，对你们仍是不洁的；

text_en: The pig, for even though it has divided hoofs and is cleft-footed, it does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.
text_cn: 猪，它虽有偶蹄，蹄虽有趾，却不反刍，对你们仍是不洁的。

text_en: Of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch; they are unclean for you.
text_cn: 这些走兽的肉，你们不可吃；它们的尸体，也不可触摸，因为对你们都是不洁的。

text_en: These you may eat, of all that are in the waters. Everything in the waters that has fins and scales, whether in the seas or in the streams—such you may eat.
text_cn: 水族中你们可吃的如下：凡是水中有鳍有鳞的，不论是海里的，或河里的，都可以吃；

text_en: But anything in the seas or the streams that does not have fins and scales, of the swarming creatures in the waters and among all the other living creatures that are in the waters—they are detestable to you
text_cn: 但凡在水中蠕动，和在水中生存的生物，若没有鳍和鳞，不论是海里，或河里的，都是你们所当憎恶的。

text_en: and detestable they shall remain. Of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall regard as detestable.
text_cn: 这些水族，都是你们所当憎恶的：它们的肉不可吃；它们的尸体，你们当视为可憎恶之物。

text_en: Everything in the waters that does not have fins and scales is detestable to you.
text_cn: 水族中凡没有鳍和鳞的，都是你们所当憎恶的。

text_en: These you shall regard as detestable among the birds. They shall not be eaten; they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,
text_cn: 飞禽中，你们应视为可憎而不可吃，应视为可憎之物的是：鹰、鹗（è）、鹫（jiù）、

text_en: the buzzard, the kite of any kind;
text_cn: 鸢（yuān）及隼（sǔn）之类；

text_en: every raven of any kind;
text_cn: 凡乌鸦之类；

text_en: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the sea gull, the hawk of any kind;
text_cn: 鸵鸟、夜鹰、海鸥和苍鹰之类；

text_en: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
text_cn: 小枭（xiāo）、鸬（lú）鹚（cí）和鸱（chī）鸺（xiū），

text_en: the water hen, the desert owl, the carrion vulture,
text_cn: 白鹭、塘鹅和白鹫，

text_en: the stork, the heron of any kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
text_cn: 鹳鹭类、戴胜和蝙蝠。

text_en: All winged insects that walk upon all fours are detestable to you.
text_cn: 凡是有翅，四足爬行的昆虫，都是你们所当憎恶的；

text_en: But among the winged insects that walk on all fours you may eat those that have jointed legs above their feet, with which to leap on the ground.
text_cn: 但在有翅，四足爬行的昆虫中，凡有脚以外，还有大腿，在地上能跳的，你们可以吃。

text_en: Of them you may eat: the locust according to its kind, the bald locust according to its kind, the cricket according to its kind, and the grasshopper according to its kind.
text_cn: 你们可吃的是：飞蝗之类，蚱蜢之类，蟋蟀之类和螽（zhōng）斯之类；

text_en: But all other winged insects that have four feet are detestable to you.
text_cn: 其他凡有翅，四足爬行的昆虫，都是你们所当憎恶的。

text_en: By these you shall become unclean; whoever touches the carcass of any of them shall be unclean until the evening,
text_cn: 遇到以下的光景也能使你们不洁：凡触摸这些昆虫尸体的人，直到晚上不洁；

text_en: and whoever carries any part of the carcass of any of them shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening.
text_cn: 凡移动它们尸体的人，应洗涤自己的衣服，直到晚上是不洁的。

text_en: Every animal that has divided hoofs but is not cleft-footed or does not chew the cud is unclean for you; everyone who touches one of them shall be unclean.
text_cn: 凡有偶蹄而无趾的，或不反刍的走兽，为你们都是不洁的；谁触摸了就染上不洁。

text_en: All that walk on their paws, among the animals that walk on all fours, are unclean for you; whoever touches the carcass of any of them shall be unclean until the evening,
text_cn: 一切四足动物中，凡用脚掌行走的，为你们都是不洁的；谁触摸了它们的尸体，直到晚上是不洁的；

text_en: and the one who carries the carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening; they are unclean for you.
text_cn: 谁移动了它们的尸体，应洗涤自己的衣服，直到晚上是不洁的。这些动物为你们都是不洁的。

text_en: These are unclean for you among the creatures that swarm upon the earth: the weasel, the mouse, the great lizard according to its kind,
text_cn: 在地上爬行的动物中，为你们不洁的是：鼹(yǎn)鼠、老鼠和蜥蜴之类；

text_en: the gecko, the land crocodile, the lizard, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.
text_cn: 壁虎、避役、蛇舅母、乌龟和伶鼬(yòu)。

text_en: These are unclean for you among all that swarm; whoever touches one of them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.
text_cn: 这些爬行的动物，为你们都是不洁的；它们死后，谁触摸了，直到晚上是不洁的。

text_en: And anything upon which any of them falls when they are dead shall be unclean, whether an article of wood or cloth or skin or sacking, any article that is used for any purpose; it shall be dipped into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening, and then it shall be clean.
text_cn: 其中死了的，掉在什么物件上，不论是木器，或衣服，或皮具，或囊袋，凡能用的器具，即成为不洁，应放入水内，直到晚上是不洁的；以后，才算洁净；

text_en: And if any of them falls into any earthen vessel, all that is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break the vessel.
text_cn: 一切陶器，如有它们中一个掉在里面，里面所有的一切即成为不洁，陶器应该打破；

text_en: Any food that could be eaten shall be unclean if water from any such vessel comes upon it; and any liquid that could be drunk shall be unclean if it was in any such vessel.
text_cn: 如里面的水滴在任何食物上，食物即成为不洁的；在这种陶器内装了任何饮料，饮料也成为不洁的。

text_en: Everything on which any part of the carcass falls shall be unclean; whether an oven or stove, it shall be broken in pieces; they are unclean, and shall remain unclean for you.
text_cn: 它们的尸体无论掉在什么东西上，那东西即成为不洁的：不拘炉或灶都应打碎，因为是不洁的，你们也应视为不洁。

text_en: But a spring or a cistern holding water shall be clean, while whatever touches the carcass in it shall be unclean.
text_cn: 水泉和蓄水池虽是洁净的，但是那接触尸体的，即成为不洁。

text_en: If any part of their carcass falls upon any seed set aside for sowing, it is clean;
text_cn: 如果他们中一个尸体掉在要播种的种籽上，种籽仍是洁净的；

text_en: but if water is put on the seed and any part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.
text_cn: 但若种籽已浸了水，而尸体掉在上面，这种籽对你们便成了不洁的。

text_en: If an animal of which you may eat dies, anyone who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
text_cn: 若你们可吃的一只走兽死了，谁触摸了它的尸体，直到晚上是不洁的；

text_en: Those who eat of its carcass shall wash their clothes and be unclean until the evening; and those who carry the carcass shall wash their clothes and be unclean until the evening.
text_cn: 谁吃了这尸体的肉，应洗涤自己的衣服，并且直到晚上是不洁的；谁移动了这尸体，也应洗涤自己的衣服，而且直到晚上是不洁的。

text_en: All creatures that swarm upon the earth are detestable; they shall not be eaten.
text_cn: 凡地上的爬虫，都是当憎恶的，都不可吃。

text_en: Whatever moves on its belly, and whatever moves on all fours, or whatever has many feet, all the creatures that swarm upon the earth, you shall not eat; for they are detestable.
text_cn: 不论是用腹部爬行的，或用四足爬行的，或多足的，凡是地上的爬虫，你们都不可吃，因为都是可憎恶的。

text_en: You shall not make yourselves detestable with any creature that swarms; you shall not defile yourselves with them, and so become unclean.
text_cn: 你们不要因任何爬虫而使你们成为可憎恶的；你们不要因它们而成为不洁的，或染上不洁，

text_en: For I am the Lord your God; sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any swarming creature that moves on the earth.
text_cn: 因为我上主是你们的天主：你们该表现为圣洁的，你们应是圣的，因为我是圣的。你们不要因地上的任何爬虫，而使自己成为不洁的，

text_en: For I am the Lord who brought you up from the land of Egypt, to be your God; you shall be holy, for I am holy.
text_cn: 因为是我上主领你们由埃及地上来，为作你们的天主：你们应是圣的，因为我是圣的。

text_en: This is the law pertaining to land animal and bird and every living creature that moves through the waters and every creature that swarms upon the earth,
text_cn: 以上是有关走兽飞禽，一切水中游行和地上一切爬行动物的法律，

text_en: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living creature that may be eaten and the living creature that may not be eaten.
text_cn: 以便分别洁与不洁，可吃与不可吃的生物。”
